text:
Maria: Quick idea — add an 'opaque_sample' mode to the sampler. Store only a per-request fingerprint + provenance_id, no request/response body. That way we can link traces for debugging without keeping PII.
Evan: interesting. how would teams correlate the provenance_id back to full data during ops? can we do safe unmask flows? :thinking:
Maria: ops-only unmask would require strict RBAC + audit logs. plan is: provenance_id -> short-lived replay token that can only be minted via console with legal/engineering approval.
Jamal: quota impact? if samples are opaque we lose payload size metrics. dashboards will be blind for token/cost heatmaps.
Sophie: UX idea: surface 'sample confidence' and an action button "Request Replay" which automates the ticket+approval flow. show a redacted preview in-console. :white_check_mark:
Dena: legal/reg compliance here — some regs forbid reconstructing certain PII even for debug. we need opt-outs per-tenant and an allowlist for debugable routes.
Evan: request: telemetry should still emit minimal metrics: sample_source, provenance_id, route, model, token_count_bucket. no bodies. that keeps cost dashboards and routing telemetry intact.
Maria: prototype config (sampler policy):
```
sampler:
  default: opaque_sample
  modes:
    opaque_sample:
      keep_body: false
      fingerprint: sha256(req_id + user_tenant)
      provenance_field: provenance_id
      replay_ttl: 10m
      mint_policy: console+owners
```
Jamal: tiny nit — using tenant in the fingerprint changes dedupe. maybe use route+partial-hash so we can see duplicate traffic patterns without tenant leakage.
Dena: also require tokenization fallback for embeddings routes. embeddings can leak user data if stored even hashed.
Sophie: on the console: when a replay is requested show (1) who requested, (2) reason, (3) redaction preview, (4) link to audit log entry. we should also rate-limit replays per-tenant.
Maria: thought about replay flow: console mints a one-time replay_token that decrypts ephemeral store for 5m and autologs the requester + git sha. no bodies persist after TTL.
Evan: how about metrics for compliance? add a telemetry flag `replay_request` with outcome (granted/denied/auto-denied) and approver_id. we can hook that into the audit retention pipeline.
ops-bot: deploy preview available at https://staging.redwood-inference/opaque-sampler — run `curl -X POST /test-sample` to try. :robot_face:
Jamal: I'll run a small canary against high-traffic routes and monitor latency impact. pinging @Sophie for the UI bits.
Sophie: happy to mock the Request Replay modal. will add a 'safety checklist' step: legal checkbox + approver dropdown.
Dena: can we add per-tenant flags: `allow_debug_replay: true|false` and default false? legal wants explicit enable.
Maria: agreed. we'll wire that into tenant onboarding and Dedicated contracts.
Evan: ok — next steps: (1) prototype opaque_sample in runtime (Jamal), (2) console replay flow mock (Sophie), (3) telemetry schema for provenance fields (Evan), (4) legal gating + tenant flag (Dena). I'll create a GH tracking issue.
Maria: thanks all — will post an RFC draft this week. :rocket:
